hook: The captain whose fleet was the first to sail around the world.

pages.x: Fernão de Magalhães was born around 1480 in Portugal and served as a page at court. He sailed to India and Malacca, and was wounded in battle in Morocco. When King Manuel refused him a small raise in pay, he left for Spain.
He told the young king of Spain that he could reach the Spice Islands by sailing west, through a passage around South America. In September 1519 he left Seville with five ships and about 270 men.

Wintering on the cold coast of Patagonia, three of his captains rebelled. Magellan crushed the mutiny, executed one and marooned another. One ship was wrecked. His men met tall local people and called their land Patagonia.

In October 1520 he found a twisting channel through the tip of South America, now the Strait of Magellan. It took 38 days to get through, and another ship deserted. Seeing the calm ocean beyond, he named it the Pacific, "peaceful".

No one knew the Pacific was so vast. For 99 days they saw no inhabited land. The crew ate biscuits crawling with worms, rats, and the leather wrapped round the masts, softened in seawater. Scurvy killed many of them.

In the Philippines Magellan made allies and converts, and in April 1521 attacked Mactan, whose chief, Lapulapu, refused to submit. Magellan was killed in the shallows. Lapulapu is a national hero of the Philippines.

In September 1522 one battered ship, the Victoria, limped back to Spain under Juan Sebastián Elcano, with 18 men: the first ever to sail around the world. To their amazement, their calendar was a day behind.
Magellan did not live to finish it, but his expedition was the first to sail around the world. It proved the oceans are all connected, and showed how big the Earth really is.
pts: Led the first voyage around the world
